notes: Audited read-only meters window. Session loading and account switching now follow the same proven flow as the stable Domlight client and AutoCheck module. Meter parsing is hardened to keep type, number, value, date and verification data within each individual meter card. Meter reading submission remains disabled. The window still uses the normal service POST /account/set only to switch accounts, exactly as the stable receipt checker does. Local data, receipts and settings are preserved.
